channel.title: First Principles Daily
channel.description:
A daily narrative podcast that reasons about the world from first principles — Elon Musk's 'magic wand number' and 'Idiot Index'. Episodes alternate between a concrete example of first-principles thinking inside one of Musk's companies and a deep exposé on an industry ripe for the same treatment.
AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.

item.title: Ep 1: Raptor engines now approach a small fraction of legacy costs because their designers started from the raw metals and physics rather than inherited blueprints.
item.description: Raptor engines now approach a small fraction of legacy costs because their designers started from the raw metals and physics rather than inherited blueprints. Segment 1 — The Cold Open A single turbopump housing in an older rocket engine once carried a price tag dozens of times higher than the specialty alloy inside it. That gap is not unusual; it is the default in most engineered systems. ...
